claude_code.enforcement_boundary: local hook, fail-open; no provider-side guarantee

litellm.billing_authority: gateway estimate when response_cost is supplied; otherwise list-rate equivalent

otel_offline.billing_authority: source-specific imported claim; not provider-billed without source authentication

openai_agents_offline.status: offline mapping against local fakes only

langgraph_offline.status: offline mapping against local fakes only
langgraph_offline.identity: derived graph identity with replay watermark
langgraph_offline.billing_authority: unknown unless independent evidence is imported; provider-billed requires authentication

resource_envelopes.maximum_overrun: not bounded outside the stated local transaction boundary

policy_failure.ci: fail-closed only when explicitly selected by protected CI configuration or adapter constructor

receipt.valuation_groups: all active alternatives retained; selected canonical view is non-additive and reasoned
receipt.timing: service/wait interval unions and elapsed envelope require complete explicit intervals; non-trivial critical path is withheld until scheduling dependencies are typed (only the trivial one-span case is populated)

comparison.status: implemented experimental under release hold; field and demand gates incomplete
comparison.diagnostic_mode: for two valid existing canonical run IDs, may emit a scoped observed delta and always abstains with COMPARISON_MANIFEST_REQUIRED; missing or malformed runs are invalid
comparison.matched_mode: requires digest-bound baseline and candidate forecost.compare-arm/1 manifests plus a strict predeclared policy
comparison.outcomes: active decisive deterministic test_exit or build_exit evidence bound to declared evidence and source IDs
comparison.meter_eligibility: all receipt meters must be final delta observations with complete one-to-one coverage by the selected list_rate valuation groups
comparison.snapshot: SQLite Backup API copy to a private in-memory database includes committed WAL pages; decisions read the exact validated copy
comparison.projection_validation: journal chain is verified and journal-derived identity/run/span/link/meter/charge/outcome projections are deterministically rebuilt and hash-compared; broken chain, mismatch, or recognized rebuild failure is invalid/exit 4
comparison.journal_validation_cap: more than 1000000 global journal observations abstains with PROJECTION_VALIDATION_RESOURCE_LIMIT
comparison.reconciliation_boundary: any reconciliation_batches row forces RECONCILIATION_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED abstention because reconciliation state is outside the journal-derived validation inventory
comparison.uncertainty: deterministic paired bootstrap confidence bounds; seed is fixed-protocol plus sorted quantitative paired observations and excludes caller-chosen labels
comparison.integrity: local journal/projection and SHA-256 serialization consistency only; not a signature or same-UID guarantee
comparison.mcp: forecost_compare_runs exposes diagnostic mode only; no full manifest evaluation or live budget mutation over MCP

not_claimed: provider-billed cost without an authenticated provider source/profile
